extension.summary: Movies and TV shows from user-configured M3U feeds
extension.description: Appi caches configurable movie and TV M3U catalogues, provides fast indexed browsing, unified search, recently played lists, lightweight metadata and external FFmpeg download-script generation.
extension.news: 0.7.10 - Fix the search prompt-to-results navigation handoff while preserving the clean 0.7.9 feature scope and 0.7.8 playback implementation.
